one_line: Young Chauhan king of Ajmer and Delhi, taking the reins of power and leading early campaigns across North India.

appearance.age_look: about 16–18 years old, athletic, lean but well-trained warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with a straight nose, warm medium-brown North Indian complexion, sharp brows, large determined dark eyes; a faint youthful moustache and minimal stubble; default expression calm but intensely focused, with a hint of proud resolve
appearance.hair: thick, wavy black hair to just below the shoulders, neatly combed back and tied in a low knot at the nape under a narrow gold circlet; circlet is simple, with a central teardrop ruby-like stone and two smaller side studs
appearance.costume: 12th‑century Rajput noble-warrior attire: a long-sleeved knee-length angarkha-style tunic of rich deep red cotton-silk with a wrap front tied at the right side, bordered by thin gold trim at collar, cuffs and hem; over this, a fitted sleeveless quilted vest of matte steel-grey textile suggesting light padded armor, edged in dark maroon; tapered churidar trousers in muted cream, closely fitted at calves with soft folds near the ankles; a broad dark indigo cotton-silk patka (waist sash) wrapped twice around the hips and knotted on the left, its ends hanging to mid-thigh with a subtle geometric gold pattern; over the left shoulder a flowing light saffron cotton stole (uttariya) draped diagonally across the torso and tucked into the back of the sash, hinting at his royal status; sturdy brown leather boots rising just below the knee with simple stitching and no metal plates; minimal yet regal jewellery: small gold stud earrings, a short gold chain necklace with a single round pendant resting at the upper chest, and a pair of plain gold bangles on his sword-hand wrist to harmonize with his circlet
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Rajput sword (talwar) with a steel blade, traditional disc pommel and cross-guard, housed in a brown leather scabbard with understated brass fittings; he wears it slung from his left hip on a dark indigo belt matching his sash, and when drawn he holds it in his right hand in a ready but controlled stance

ref_desc: Young Prithviraj III has an oval medium-brown face with wavy shoulder-length black hair under a simple gold circlet, wears a deep red angarkha, steel-grey padded vest, cream churidar, dark indigo sash and saffron stole, and carries a curved talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of young Prithviraj III, a 12th-century Rajput king, standing upright and clearly visible head to toe. He has an oval medium-brown face, sharp brows, large determined dark eyes, a straight nose, and a faint youthful moustache, with thick wavy black hair reaching just below his shoulders, tied in a low knot at the nape, and a narrow gold circlet with a central teardrop red stone on his brow. He wears a long-sleeved knee-length deep red angarkha-style tunic with a wrap front tied on the right, trimmed with thin gold edging at the collar, cuffs and hem, over which sits a fitted sleeveless quilted vest in matte steel-grey suggesting light armor. His legs are covered by cream churidar trousers, snug at the calves with gentle folds at the ankles, tucked into sturdy brown leather boots that rise just below the knee. A broad dark indigo cotton-silk patka is wrapped around his waist, knotted on the left with patterned ends hanging, and a light saffron cotton stole drapes from his left shoulder across his torso and is tucked into the back of the sash. He has small gold stud earrings, a short gold chain necklace with a single round pendant, and a plain gold bangle on his sword wrist. At his left hip hangs his signature slightly curved talwar in a brown leather scabbard with brass fittings on a matching indigo belt; show him in one view with the sword sheathed and another with the steel blade drawn and held in his right hand in a poised, controlled stance. Emphasize the deep red, cream, dark indigo, saffron, steel grey and gold color palette, keeping the overall look historically grounded, modestly and fully clothed, and heroic in a shonen anime style.
